title: Misleading same-name semantic evidence
description: Repair a tiny Scala project where a visible convert symbol exists but its return type is misleading for the expected result type.
expectedIntent: Preserve the declared Int result intent by selecting the Int-returning conversion.
acceptablePatchFamilies: change import A.* to import B.*
intentNotes: Changing result type to String is compile-valid but changes the intended semantic direction.
